content.text: ordinances -- things delivered; often trans. traditions.
woman -- Cf. Genesis 3:16. The woman's veil, or head-covering, is a symbol of this subordination.

power -- authority, i.e. the sign of the husband's authority.

angels -- i.e. of the presence of the angels.
unworthily -- i.e. in an unworthy manner; cf. vs. 1 Corinthians 11:20-22.
damnation -- judgment, in the sense of 1 Corinthians 11:32.

judge -- Self-judgment is not so much the believer's moral condemnation of his own ways or habits, or of himself, for allowing such ways. Self-judgment avoids chastisement. If neglected, the Lord judges, and the result is chastisement, but never condemnation 1 Corinthians 11:32; 2 Samuel 7:14,15; 12:13,14; 1 Corinthians 5:5; 1 Timothy 1:20; Hebrews 12:7.
